test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.

options.text: The teacher told him to watch his grammer.
My friend happend by around dinnertime.
That was an impressive and an irresistable necklace.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Thousands protested the election fraud**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the sentence in option 1 is free of any spelling error.**
 
• The correct spelling of "thousands," "protested," and "election" is used in this sentence.
 
• "Grammar" is misspelled in Option 2.
 
• "Happened" is misspelled in Option 3.
 
• "Irresistible" is misspelled in Option 4.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "Grammar" should be spelled with an "a" instead of an "e" to be correct.
 
 
• "Grammar" means the rules of a language, for example for forming words or joining words together in sentences. (व्याकरण)
 
 
 
• Option 3: "Happened" should have an "e" after "n" to be correct.
 
 
• 
 "To happen" means (of an event or situation) to take place, usually without being planned first. (किसी घटना या स्थिति का) घटित हो जाना
 
 
 
 
• Option 4: "Irresistible" should have an "i" instead of 'a" to be correct.
 
 
• "Irresistible" means so strong that it cannot be stopped or prevented. (अप्रतिरोध्य)
